Marshall must head out for a rescue on his own when Katie calls with an emergency; the PAW Patrol must rescue a family of deer who are stuck on the slippery ice.
Rubble gets into trouble while pretending to be a super pup; the PAW Patrol must help Ryder find his robot pup.
Gil is convinced a yeti is to blame when sleeping bags go missing.
The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can't get out of town to the home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a stadium to hold the derby right in Builder Cove; Surf's up for Rubble & Crew, if they can get over the super hot sand.

Everyone in the Old West town of Harmony Valley loves playing music together; when noisy Billy Joe Strumlouder rides into town to sabotage their tunes, Sheriff Zooli must save the day.
When a scheme to cheat in a race with rocket skis backfires on Crusher, Blaze and Grammy set off on a rescue.
When Starla, the friendly cowgirl truck, loses one of her pistons, Blaze and AJ try to get it back before Crusher can take it.
Blaze and AJ use an engineering design inspired by their new dinosaur-truck friends to save Zeg from a far-away mud pit.
When Crusher steals Stripes' jungle horn, Blaze and Stripes speed after him in a chase to get it back.

Dinosaur Blaze is teaming up with his pal Zeg to compete in the Dino Derby.
Crusher uses a robot plate to try and steal Darington's birthday cake, but his plan goes awry, and the cake goes rocketing away.
When Crusher unleashes three of his most destructive creations on Axle City, only Robot Blaze is strong enough to save the day.
When Crusher cheats during a tropical island race with Blaze, AJ manages to rescue his best friend while overcoming obstacles.

New lifeguard David Hasselhawg teaches the Cadets important life-saving skills, but the Cadets have to go and rescue Davey; Survivor Bear leads a tour, but finds himself in need of a "Top Wing" rescue.
The Cadets rescue famous author Trini Treegoat; the car Earl built for Shirley's round-the-Island race doesn't work exactly as planned.

When Della Dodo's eggs are washed away, the Cadets must save Della's little brothers and sisters; when Baddy takes Trini for a tour of Big Swirl's most dangerous areas, he nearly gets them trapped in Cave-in Cavern.
When Yumi's crops begin to sprout huge vegetables, the PAW Patrol must corral the stampeding produce; the pups draw a message for space aliens on Farmer Al's field.
The Pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole; the PAW Patrol must help a dolphin pup get back into the bay with her parents.
When the pups and Cap'n Turbot camp out under a magical moon, they are transformed into mer-pups so they can perform an underwater rescue.
When a storm blows through the town right before a concert, the pups must work together to clean up the mess; Mayor Goodway's backpack slips down the side of a cliff with Chickaletta in it.
Buddy, the playful dragon from one of Alex's books, gets out and the pups need to get him back; Francois' trailer comes unhooked and all of his critters get loose.
Cap'n Turbot's weather blimp is taken by Mayor Humdinger, who plans to use it to change the weather in Foggy Bottom; Mr. Porter's stove explodes right before the chili cook-off.
Daring Danny X accidentally drives off with turtle eggs; Farmer Al's sheep run away, and Mayor Humdinger's kittens go missing.

When Grocer Gabriel and Sierra Sparkle both need construction help before Banana Day, Rubble and Crew have their paws full; Speed Meister shines his face in the sky with the lighthouse, but when a ship needs that light, the pups jump into action.
When Speed Meister steals Rubble and Crew's bus, the pups have to stop it in time for Sierra Sparkle's big concert; if Rubble and Crew build a lifeguard tower, the beach can open.

After Speed Meister builds an unsafe playground, Rubble & Crew get creative and build a new one with old materials; the town Chili Cookaroo is threatened when City Hall's roof starts to cave in; luckily, the pups know just how to fix it.

Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall; when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

Mix and Rubble are starstruck when their favorite TV renovation star, Hank Hammer, comes to see them at work; Cap'n Turbot is bringing Mayor Goodway to visit her sister, Mayor Greatway; when a fog rolls in, the pups must build a lighthouse quickly.
